cells.tense: You're reading the room before anyone speaks and you trust what you're getting.
cells.ask: Give the knowing a frame — build one structure around what you already see, and watch it hold. What returns is something you can hand to somebody else.
cells.core:
You know what matters before you can say why, and you've stopped needing the why first. Things land without argument. You sit with a question open and it doesn't scare you — the answer arrives when it arrives, and you're fine in the meantime.

A day of this looks like a kitchen where things get made without a recipe. You look at what's in front of you and reach for the right thing, and it works. That's not luck. What you're free to give it now is shape — take one of those clear readings and build something around it, so other people can stand in it with you.
cells.sheetLine: You know what matters, and you don't argue with the knowing.
cells.verb: knowing what matters before you can say how you know
cells.place: in the quiet room where recognition happens before explanation

cells.tense: You're gathering more and more, bracing for a moment when you'll finally know enough.
cells.ask: Let one thing stay unknown — pick what you've been circling and walk on without the last piece. What returns is direction: the pull that doesn't need the whole map to be felt.
cells.core:
Running well, this is plain appetite — you love the material, you keep turning it over, and the wanting keeps you close to what's alive. Lately that same hunger has turned into holding. Every question pulls more research toward it, every choice opens more angles, and the pile grows so the moment of deciding keeps sliding back. Knowing everything first has become the condition for moving at all, and the covering you've been building is starting to read as a wall.

The piece you're missing was never more information. It's the one thing you actually want, and you've been keeping it underneath everything you've stacked on top of it. Stop stacking for an afternoon. Whatever pulls at you when nothing's covering it — that's the pull.

cells.tense: You've lost the thread on what you already knew and you keep asking other people to confirm it.
cells.ask: Let one thing be unclear and still move — take a step you can't fully see, small enough that you can't get it wrong. What comes back is footing: a next step inside the fog.
cells.core:
When this is working, the knowing shows up before the reasoning does — you walk into a room and just catch what's going on, and you act on it. Lately the knowing comes and you wave it off, or you carry it to somebody else to check. Nobody trusts what they can't point to, and you've stopped trusting it too. What you keep looking for outside is something you already have.

A day of this doesn't look like certainty. It looks like walking a road in fog with enough light to see the next ten feet — you go anyway, and you go calmly. That's the whole ask. One unclear thing, one step taken without checking with anyone, and the footing returns as you use it.
cells.sheetLine: You know things and keep asking others to confirm them.

cells.tense: You're making calls you'd swear were practical, and later they turn out to have been readings.
cells.ask: Name one thing you knew that turned out right — say it plainly and take it as yours. What returns is proportion: credit and result back in line with each other.
cells.core:
This is nothing mystical when it runs clean — a person walks into a room and says the right thing without rehearsing it, and the ease comes from noticing and owning what was noticed. You notice things, then act as though you didn't. A decision gets made, you call it reasonable, and only afterward does it turn out to have been what you saw first and set aside. The insight shaped the call, and you filed it under coincidence.

The reading was there the whole time. You just don't put your name on it. Take one, out loud, where you can hear yourself say it — not a story about a feeling, just the plain sentence of what you saw and what happened next.
cells.sheetLine: You see things clearly and credit the seeing to chance.
